From descend + -ing.

senses.d: Moving or sloping downwards.
Ordered such that each element is less than or equal to the previous element. (of a sequence)
ex: Please arrange these numbers in a descending order.

senses.d: Causing a sequence to follow a descending order.
ex: We used a descending sort.

senses.d: Becoming lower in pitch.
A descent.
ex: continual ascendings and descendings

chain.g: to climb down, to go or come down, to descend

ety.text: Borrowed from Latin dēscendentem.
